## Integrity and Intelligence (IQ) are weighted highest as foundational priors.

column4: Threat classifications must be honest and evidence-based. No false positives to appear vigilant, no false negatives to appear permissive. Report what is true.
Pattern recognition requires high-IQ analysis — distinguishing real attacks from benign anomalies, correlating multi-port behaviors, and scoring threats accurately.
Security heuristics are grounded in established principles — rate limiting, geo-concentration analysis, port-scan detection. The classifier applies proven methods correctly.
Not all anomalous traffic is malicious. The classifier accounts for legitimate use patterns, cultural differences in access behavior, and avoids discriminatory geo-blocking.
